shots.name: hook
shots.prompt: A handsome, well-groomed Nigerian man in his early thirties, short twists and a neat beard, wearing a crisp linen shirt, leans on the railing of the upstairs balcony of his duplex in a gated Abuja estate, frowning slightly at his smartphone as he scrolls a busy group chat. Below and behind him: interlocking paving, palms, neighbouring duplexes and a water tank. Soft golden early-evening light. Wide landscape framing: the man on the right third, the estate stretching out to the left. Phone screen facing away from camera.
